correctness.rationale: Every commuting nilpotent has unique four-coordinate centralizer form with two zero constant terms. The explicit square and higher-power formulas imply all rank profiles. Valuation counts and the q-1 factorization count for a prescribed nonzero product partition the locus and recover \(q^{n+1}\) matrices. Second rank differences determine each Jordan partition, and an independent actual-matrix checker exhaustively confirms 113305 field instances, including GF4 and GF9. These experiments are corroborative; the argument is infinite-family.

value.rationale: An exact complete q-polynomial multiplicity census for every Jordan orbit intersecting a natural nilpotent hook centralizer refines prior existence/support and square-zero restrictions. The characteristic-uniform correction at the boundary 2s=n-1, the complete non-square-zero strata, and the geometric reciprocal limiting largest-block law make the invariant meaningful for finite-field centralizer and commuting-pair enumeration without requiring a general theorem for all partitions.
